title: Paperclip cross-tenant agent API-token creation
summary: The Paperclip advisory describes a missing tenant-authorization check that can permit creation of an API token for an agent in another company. It attributes discovery to the pwnkit AI-assisted scanner during a variant search and reports manual verification in an isolated instance; this is distinct from an earlier import-handler issue.
ai_role: The advisory explicitly credits discovery to the pwnkit AI-assisted scanner and describes manual isolated-instance verification.
classification_note: The reviewed original source documents public disclosure; unknown zero-day status is not inferred.
remediation_note: The advisory identifies 2026.416.0 as the corrected release. A documented correction does not establish deployment or current safety.
